## Summary

Describe what this PR changes and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest` (or targeted tests) pass locally
- [ ] New/changed behavior is covered by tests or justified
- [ ] `ruff check src/ tests/` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check src/ tests/` passes

## Security and Data Handling

- [ ] No secrets added
- [ ] Tenant isolation unaffected (or explicitly addressed)
- [ ] Sensitive fields/logging considerations reviewed

## Docs and Ops Impact

- [ ] Docs updated (README/docs/ADR) where needed
- [ ] Breaking changes called out clearly
- [ ] Follow-up tasks/issues created if scope was intentionally reduced

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is clear and actionable
- [ ] Changes are focused and scoped to one primary objective
